Collaborating closely with our Air Traffic Strategy Managers and front-line teams, you'll interpret complex data and transform it into actionable recommendations that impact our business units across United.

Key Responsibilities:

- Utilize your expertise to leverage and operationalize large data sets, enhancing decision support for our front-line personnel.
- Build, develop, and validate operational dashboards and analyses that are strategically and tactically aligned, providing answers to critical operational questions.
- Translate data into practical operational examples and recommendations that will support front-line teams.
- Guarantee quality assurance and quality control to ensure the integrity of our data, a crucial aspect of maintaining the accuracy of our insights.

Qualifications

What’s needed to succeed (Minimum Qualifications):

- Studying a relevant field (e.g., Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, Aeronautics, Air Traffic), or equivalent practical experience.
- Proven expertise in applied statistics and empirical data analysis techniques, with a track record of applying these skills to real-world scenarios.
- Proficiency in data manipulation and analysis tools/languages such as Python, SQL, etc.
- Experience in designing and creating operational dashboards using tools like Tableau, Power BI, or similar.
- Strong communication skills, enabling effective collaboration with cross-functional teams and the ability to translate complex findings into actionable insights.
- Adept problem-solving abilities and a keen attention to detail.
- An understanding of air traffic control operations and the aviation industry is a plus.

Preferred Qualifications

- Demonstrated understanding of the capabilities and limitations of generative AI tools and the ability to leverage AI effectively to support research, analysis, content creation, and problem-solving. Applies critical thinking to validate AI-generated outputs while adhering to organizational policies related to responsible AI use, data privacy, and security.
